prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single reusable raster picture for the FRONT of a Japanese vocabulary flashcard in the Haru Japanese learning website. Art direction: warm Japanese stationery / contemporary picture-book gouache, hand-painted matte pigment with very fine paper-grain texture, softly rounded simplified shapes, restrained natural detail, clean silhouette, flat gentle volume, subtle warm forest-green details #285B45, sage #B5C3A4, muted terracotta #C2855D, cream #F7F6F1. Quiet, friendly and mature enough for adult learners, never plastic 3D, never emoji or a vector icon. Composition: single clearly identifiable subject, full subject visible, centered, occupy about 65% of the canvas with generous clear margins, small soft ground shadow only, ideally 4:3 landscape 1536x1152. Background must be truly transparent alpha, not white and not a checkerboard. No card border, no frame, no circular background, no UI. Absolutely no writing, no letters, no Japanese characters, no labels, no watermark; the learner must identify the subject without being shown the answer. Production asset, not a collage or contact sheet.
Subject: one healthy orange-and-cream domestic cat sitting calmly in three-quarter view, four anatomically sensible legs with front paws visible, a softly curved tail beside the body, triangular ears, small gentle eyes and fine whiskers. The cat is the sole subject; no collar, toys, bowl, books or other objects.

Subject: one friendly two-storey Japanese elementary school building seen in a slightly elevated three-quarter front view, symmetrical cream facade, muted terracotta pitched roof, a prominent circular analog clock centered over the main entrance, repeated classroom windows, small simple entrance steps and a tiny planted patch. It must read unmistakably as a school building rather than a private house. No signs, no flag, no people, no numbers or writing anywhere. The entire building and roof fit within the canvas.
